abstract: Pure testicular choriocarcinoma is an extremely rare subtype of nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, accounting for less than 1% of all germ cell tumors and only 0.19% of all testicular tumors. It is a highly aggressive malignant tumor with early multiorgan metastasis and poor prognosis. We present a case of 23-year-old male presented to the hospital with mild hemoptysis which was thought as a sequela of his past COVID-19 pneumonia infection, however; chest radiograph showed multiple rounded cannonball opacities seen throughout both lungs raising the suspicion of metastatic deposits to the lungs. During physical examination, left testicular painless swelling was noted leading to an ultrasound of the scrotum which revealed a left intratesticular infiltrative, heterogeneous mass. Tumor markers, including beta-human chorionic gonadotropin, lactate dehydrogenase and alpha fetoprotein were extremely high. Computed tomography scan of the brain, chest, abdomen, and pelvis showed hemorrhagic metastatic deposits to the brain, chest, and left para-aortic lymph nodes. The patient underwent radical orchiectomy and histopathology reports confirmed the diagnosis of pure testicular choriocarcinoma.
abstract_ja: 精巣純粋絨毛癌は、非常にまれな非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の亜型であり、全胚細胞腫瘍の1%未満、全精巣腫瘍の0.19%しか占めない。早期の多臓器転移を伴う非常に侵襲性の高い悪性腫瘍であり、予後は不良である。我々は、23歳男性が軽度の喀血で来院した症例を報告する。これは以前のCOVID-19肺炎感染の後遺症と考えられていたが、胸部単純X線写真で両肺全体に多発する円形の砲弾状陰影が認められ、肺への転移巣が疑われた。身体診察では左精巣の無痛性腫脹が認められ、陰嚢超音波検査で左精巣内に浸潤性で不均一な腫瘤が確認された。腫瘍マーカー（β-hCG、乳酸脱水素酵素、αフェトプロテイン）は著明に高値であった。脳、胸部、腹部、骨盤のコンピュータ断層撮影では、脳、胸部、左傍大動脈リンパ節に出血性の転移巣が認められた。患者は根治的精巣摘除術を受け、病理組織学的検査で精巣純粋絨毛癌と確定診断された。
